PASSING_PROPERTIES: ENTRY_CAS closes all three gates and increments ENGINEERING_EPOCH plus MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH, which correctly invalidates old normal authority.
The candidate defines one Mission Fence CUTOVER_CAS for U1-to-U2 canonical universe installation.
Candidate U2 remains non-authoritative before cutover and closure is blocked during migration.
Migration completeness uses immutable record identity, roots/counts, explicit empty shards, and preserves ambiguous durable truth during crash recovery.

BLOCKING_DEFECT.SUMMARY: The protocol invalidates U1 authority globally at ENTRY_CAS but does not bind each shard's migration source to an exact pre-entry authoritative shard head/snapshot. A stale writer may physically update an as-yet-unfrozen shard after ENTRY_CAS but before that shard's freeze acknowledgement, and the later freeze can capture the polluted post-entry head. Migration then preserves the unauthorized record into U2.
WHY_EXISTING_RULES_DO_NOT_CATCH_IT: OLD_UNIVERSE_FREEZE prevents commits only after that shard's local freeze/fencing point; it does not close the interval from global ENTRY_CAS to each shard's local freeze.

The rule requiring writers to reread Mission Fence is a participant obligation, not a sink-level atomic guard. A paused/stale writer can still physically win a Git/ref CAS on a shard whose ref has not yet been fenced.

VERIFY_BEFORE_CUTOVER checks for no post-freeze authoritative U1 write, but the counterexample write occurs before local freeze and is unauthorized, so that wording does not reject a frozen snapshot already containing it.
Source denominator root/count equality only proves lossless migration of the selected frozen snapshot. It does not prove that every record in that snapshot still has pre-entry canonical authority.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: At U1, shard S is at head H0. Writer W validates a lease at ENGINEERING_EPOCH E and prepares a CAS H0->H1.
Global ENTRY_CAS succeeds, closes gates, and advances ENGINEERING_EPOCH/MEMBERSHIP_EPOCH. W is now stale and has zero mission authority.

Before shard S receives its freeze acknowledgement/fencing ref update, W resumes and physically succeeds with shard CAS H0->H1 because the shard sink has not changed and is not atomically coupled to the Mission Fence CAS.
The freezer later observes H1, establishes the shard freeze/fencing token, and records H1 as the immutable frozen U1 snapshot.
Migration denominator and manifests are computed from H1, so W's unauthorized record is treated as source input and is moved one-to-one into candidate U2.

CUTOVER_CAS installs U2. The stale post-entry write has now become canonical U2 state even though the candidate acceptance rule requires that no compliant stale U1 writer can remain canonical after ENTRY_CAS.

REQUIRED_REPAIR_V2: Bind every SHARD_UNIVERSE-routed domain/shard to an exact PRE_ENTRY_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT identity in the immutable migration intent before ENTRY_CAS, including exact ref/head or transactional snapshot id plus denominator root/count.

After ENTRY_CAS, each shard freeze operation must CAS/fence the same mutation sink from the intent-bound PRE_ENTRY_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT identity to a freeze marker/token. If the shard no longer equals that pre-entry identity, fail closed and reconcile; do not silently freeze the later observed head.

Migration input must be the intent-bound pre-entry authoritative snapshots only, never a later post-entry head. Any post-entry physical write is forensic stale evidence and must be excluded unless separately proven to precede the entry linearization point by authority evidence.
VERIFY_BEFORE_CUTOVER must prove every shard freeze marker descends from or exactly fences the intent-bound pre-entry identity without admitting an unauthorized post-entry mutation.

Add a torture test where a writer validates before ENTRY_CAS, physically commits after ENTRY_CAS but before its shard's local freeze, and verify the transition detects/rejects the changed shard head and never migrates that record.
FINDING_DISPOSITION: KEEP_OPEN; candidate V1 is materially safer but does not yet satisfy its own acceptance condition that stale U1 work cannot become canonical after ENTRY_CAS.
